scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/wallet build && bun run --cwd packages/mcp build && bun run --cwd packages/x402 build && bun packages/core/scripts/assemble.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && for p in test packages/core packages/core/test packages/wallet packages/wallet/test packages/mcp packages/mcp/test packages/x402; do tsc --noEmit -p $p || exit 1; done
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run --filter './packages/*' test
scripts.test:bun: bun run build && bun test --timeout 60000 packages/core/test packages/wallet/test test
